description: Ministry of Power and Energy - Revise the Fuel Price to be effective from 12.00 midnight On April 30,2023
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 66 of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961, revising fuel prices.
